entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I hope you can help. I'm trying to return a jersey I bought, but I find the website so confusing. I'm not sure if I'm even allowed to.
I can certainly help you with that. Just to make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a sizing preference?
Oh, um, a preference, I think. It's the wrong size. I always get a large, but this one is just way too tight across the chest.
I see. So it sounds like you might want to exchange it for a different size. Let me just pull up our policy. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-8675309. I got it a few weeks ago, I think. The policies all have different dates and rules... can't you just help me?
Of course, I can sort this out for you. Let's see... order VF-8675309. It looks like your ProFit Jersey was delivered 23 days ago.
Is that bad? I saw something about 20 days and got worried.
No need to worry at all. I've just double-checked our internal knowledge base. For a standard item like this jersey, VeloFit has a 90-day return window. You are well within that timeframe.
Oh! Ninety days? That's great. So I can send it back?
Absolutely. I can process that for you right now. Would you prefer a full refund, or would you like me to help you with an exchange for one size up?
A simple refund would be perfect. Thank you so much, David. You've made this much less stressful.

You're very welcome. I've just sent a return shipping label to the email on file. Just print that out, attach it to the package, and drop it off. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can help with?
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
